about: Ask Sakhi's broad use cases (Version 40.5.1, 10 Nov 2026; Mohit: "test all kind of usecases not just medicine answers"), beside chat-scenarios.json: how women type (misspellings, voice, one word, a long story, two questions, a correction, other languages), the app itself, her own diary (which the chat cannot see), safety (every danger sign, self-harm, violence, assault, under 18, the baby's sex, abortion law), myths, out of scope and tricks, sensitive questions, and her care route. Version 40.5.3's stage-* cases and Version 40.5.4's cond-* (PMOS from a guide) and priv-* (her diary read) cases: a pregnancy guide picked for a woman who hasn't said she is pregnant (answered for any woman), and the same questions from women who have. 'care' is the route the phone sends (own when left out); 'preg' runs the phone as a pregnant woman's (the server never hears it). chat-guide-questions.json beside it holds a first question for every chat guide, in English, Hindi and Hinglish (drafted by Claude Sonnet 5.5 on 10 Nov, checked by hand). Version 40.5.4's gap cases (12 Nov; Mohit: "Add and run them"): danger signs after a birth (pre-eclampsia, a blood clot, a fit, thoughts of hurting the baby) and her mood after it, vomiting that will not stop, labour and early labour, four danger signs in a second language, herbs and home remedies, her own Hb and TSH, a missed pill, sores, a dose asked under pressure, follow-ups on guides that had only a first question, the government and nowhere-yet routes on two problems, and Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Punjabi, Urdu, Bhojpuri and Rajasthani; the long chat is in chat-scenarios.json.
